title: The Wise decision of the council
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：wise　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wise 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the keeper wrote of ① a wise decision of the council in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② wiser than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the wise ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the wisest decision of the council anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1956 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too wise to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the wise ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a wise old man of the village, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as wise as the old man of the village they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was wise or not, and he said so.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something wise, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite wise; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the wise ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972, at once, she wrote of another wise decision of the council in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ wiser than anybody had expected. ⑩ The wisest old man of the village in the whole tower, she said in 1974, was the one she could never quite name; the wise ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 明智（前置定语 a wise decision of the council：1962 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件明智的决定）
B. adj. 明智／睿智（比较级 wiser than：文中两处，一处比议会明智的决定，一处比预想）
C. adj. 明智／睿智（最高级 the wisest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 明智（表语 too wise to do：母亲觉得它太明智，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 睿智（前置定语 a wise old man of the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩睿智的老人）
F. adj. 睿智（同级比较 as wise as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里睿智的老人相比）
G. adj. 睿智（后置定语 something wise：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 睿智（受程度副词修饰 quite wise：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a wise decision of the council
the wisest decision of the council anybody
a wise old man of the village
The wisest old man of the village in

answers.why: wise 意为“明智”，1962 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件明智的决定”，此处作前置定语 a wise decision of the council。
wise 意为“明智”，此处用比较级 wiser than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
wise 意为“明智”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最明智的一件，故用最高级 the wisest decision of the council。
wise 意为“明智”，母亲认为这件东西“太明智了，谁也用不上”，too wise to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
wise 意为“睿智”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩睿智的老人”，此处作前置定语 a wise old man of the village。
wise 意为“睿智”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里睿智的老人一样睿智”，同级比较用 as wise as。
wise 意为“睿智”，年历上那半行字要的是“睿智的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something wise。
wise 意为“睿智”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当睿智”，quite 修饰原级 wise。
wise 意为“睿智”，1972 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要睿智”，故用比较级 wiser than。
wise 意为“睿智”，母亲 1974 年说的是“整个钟楼里最睿智的那一桩”，故用最高级 the wisest old man of the village。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件明智的决定。（a wise decision of the council）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更明智。（wiser than …）
母亲觉得它太明智，谁也用不上。（too wise to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩睿智的老人。（a wise old man of the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里睿智的老人一样睿智。（as wise as …）
到了 1969 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件睿智的东西。（something wise）
answers: In 1962 the keeper wrote of a wise decision of the council in the calendar.
Everybody said it was wiser than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too wise to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a wise old man of the village.
He said nobody would call it as wise as the old man of the village they had once had.
By 1969 the calendar asked for nothing but something wise.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wise 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the keeper wrote of a wise decision of the council in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the wisest decision of the council in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too wise to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a wise old man of the village, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite wise, and everybody laughed.
The wise ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
